attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2742/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The two are anonymous on the page**, so no name form can be read for either and the entry is kept as one folder for the pair, after the pattern of `thirty-three-martyrs-of-heraclea`; `sex` is `unknown` for the same reason. No year, no place, no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
